name: Grenka's Claw
summary: Grenka's Claw is a physical trophy taken from the formidable harpy Grenka Bloodscreech in the depths of Roguefeather Den. Presented to Dorn Plainstalker at the Weathered Nook, it serves as undeniable proof that an aspiring adventurer has endured a grueling physical trial in the canyon heights.

sections.title: A Trophy of Endurance
sections.body: Within the winding caverns of Roguefeather Den, west of Freewind Post, harpies cache food and violently defend their territory against outsiders. To test the physical resilience of young champions, Dorn Plainstalker tasks them with invading the deep roosts and destroying the flock's food reserves. Such brazen provocation inevitably draws the fury of Grenka Bloodscreech. Severing and returning her wicked talon proves that a warrior can withstand wave after wave of enraged harpies and survive the vicious onslaught of their matriarch.

faq.q: What is Grenka's Claw used for?
aliases: why do i need grenkas claw
faq.answer: The claw serves as proof of victory for Dorn Plainstalker, a tauren elder residing at the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles. Handing it to him completes the Test of Endurance, demonstrating that you possess the physical grit required to survive prolonged combat.

Grenka Bloodscreech is a powerful harpy who roosts within the Roguefeather Den, located in the Screeching Canyon along the southern cliffs of Thousand Needles. She emerges only when intruders threaten the flock by destroying their stored foodstuffs.

faq.q: Where do I take the claw once I obtain it?
aliases: where to turn in grenka claw
faq.answer: Bring the claw back to Dorn Plainstalker at the Weathered Nook, nestled in the bluffs of Thousand Needles. He accepts the trophy to verify that your trial of physical endurance has succeeded.

faq.q: Why does Dorn Plainstalker demand this specific trophy?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker guides young travelers through rigorous trials to ensure they are mentally, spiritually, and physically equipped for greater perils. Slaying Grenka and claiming her claw proves that a warrior can endure both the ambush of a swarm and the direct assault of a deadly leader.

angles.text: Elder Dorn Plainstalker sees it as his sacred duty to steel young Horde champions through the wisdom and grit of tauren rites before they face the wider, harsher world.
Clearing the deep reaches of Roguefeather Den and putting down Grenka Bloodscreech blunts the harpy threat that constantly harasses travelers around Freewind Post.
